evals.prompt: My ChatQnA deployment starts, but POST /v1/chatqna/chat returns 500. I am using OpenVINO on CPU with Docker Compose. Please troubleshoot and give exact checks and fixes.
evals.expected_output: A runtime-aware troubleshooting flow for Docker OpenVINO: health/model/chat checks, backend and compose logs, likely root causes, and verification commands.

evals.prompt: I deployed with Helm and the UI URL does not load. Pods are running in namespace ai-demo. Help me debug and isolate whether this is nginx/service/nodeport related.
evals.expected_output: A Helm troubleshooting sequence using kubectl get/describe/logs plus hostIP/nodePort checks, with a concise diagnosis and corrective action.

evals.prompt: Document upload fails with 400 and sometimes 500 in ChatQnA. Show me how to troubleshoot request format vs backend ingestion/model errors.
evals.expected_output: A document ingestion diagnostic flow validating multipart payload, supported formats, /documents behavior, and log-based root-cause guidance.
